## Purpose
`close_gates.rs` runs a sequence of sub-gates (debt, checklist, findings, QA, build) and needs a typed way to carry each sub-gate's verdict plus its evidence back to the caller — this is the `*Result` role. These types are the return value of a decision/computation function, distinct from the CLI-facing `*Report` role: a Result is consumed by the next step in-process (e.g. folded into a `Verdict`), while a Report is the terminal JSON a command prints.

## Convention
Folder: apps/rt/src/commands/pipeline/**, apps/rt/src/commands/review/qa_run/** · Extension: .rs · Files of this role in this subproject: 5
`close_gates.rs` shows the pattern: sub-gate outcomes are threaded as `Verdict` (an existing enum from `mustard_core::domain::model::contract`) rather than a bespoke enum per gate where the shared `Verdict` vocabulary already fits; where a gate needs richer evidence than `Verdict` carries, a small local struct/enum is declared close to the function that produces it (mirroring `OutputBudgetResult` in the `rt-mode` cluster). Each sub-gate is its own numbered section with an env-driven `MUSTARD_*_MODE`, defaulting to `strict` for close-gates specifically (the one place a strict default is intentional per the module header) — a departure documented explicitly rather than left implicit.

## How to apply
A new pipeline sub-gate or QA-run decision function returns `Verdict` when the shared vocabulary is sufficient, or a small local `*Result` struct otherwise — declared next to its producing function, not centralized. Document the sub-gate's own mode env var and default in the function's doc comment the way each numbered gate does in `close_gates.rs`'s header.
